thread:
Alex: incident-bot just paged us for an elevated p99 on /v1/chat (region: us-west1). Lots of 503s and high tail latency. anyone oncall?
Priya: i'm oncall, grabbing it. seeing a spike in backend queue time in traces.
incident-bot: ALERT: route=/v1/chat p99=1.9s (>1.5s threshold) — paging oncall.
Morgan: I can jump in — looking at split by model now, seems concentrated on mistral-7b-v0 and gptx-16k in the same shard.
Chen: customer impact? any errors vs just slow?
Priya: mix — ~12% 5xxs last 5min, rest are elevated latencies. A couple of big customers reported timeouts in support channel.
Riley: FYI support forwarded two enterprise users in EU complaining about slow responses. Not catastrophic but repeated.
Sam: are we hitting GPU exhaustion / OOMs? metrics show kernel stalls and increased NVLink latency.
Morgan: checking node metrics — a subset of nodes shows high memory pressure and queue length. Might be a bad rollout for a quantized variant.
Priya: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-15T21:05 by infra-mission-control for mistral-7b-v0-quant. Could be related.
Alex: ok let's do live mitigation: 1) route traffic off the suspect shard 2) increase p99 alert threshold temporarily to reduce noise 3) page infra to rollback if needed.
Chen: agree. I'll open a temp route override to steer traffic to fallback pool (non-quantized). Doing now.
incident-bot: ACTION: traffic rerouted for /v1/chat -> fallback-pool (started).
Priya: after reroute p99 dropped to ~1.2s, 5xxs down to 3%. improvement but still above baseline.
Morgan: sounds like quant rollout caused instability on a few nodes. We should mute the p99 page for the route for ~30m while we stabilize to avoid cascading pages.
Sam: propose we adjust alerting sensitivity instead of pure mute: raise p99 squelch from 1.5s -> 2.2s for route=/v1/chat and set a fidelity window of 20m to avoid flapping. That keeps awareness but prevents immediate pages.
Alex: +1 to sensitivity window. Also add per-model thresholds: mistral-7b-v0 p99 -> 2.0s, gptx-16k p99 -> 2.5s for the short term. Keep p95 thresholds tighter.
Chen: I'm updating the alert config now. snippet: ```
# alert update
route: /v1/chat
p95_threshold: 450ms
p99_threshold: 2.2s
models:
  - name: mistral-7b-v0
    p99_threshold: 2.0s
  - name: gptx-16k
    p99_threshold: 2.5s
squelch_window: 20m
```
Priya: pushed. alerting system confirms updated. We also created a temporary noise_gate tag so on-call paging will only fire if error_rate>5% AND p99>threshold.
Riley: good call to gate pages with error rate. reduces unnecessary wakeups for high-tail but healthy requests.
Sam: can we add a dashboard tile for "p99 delta vs baseline" per-model and a timeline panel for deploys so incident to root-cause mapping is easier?
Alex: yes — add a new dashboard panel under "chat-performance/incident-play" with two charts: p99 by model (last 6h) and p99 delta to baseline (rolling 24h). Also include recent deploys overlay.
Morgan: created dashboard draft and gave edit access to eng-platform and oncall. Link: https://graf.redwood/dashboard/chat-performance/incident-play (placeholder).
Priya: action items: 1) infra rollback or patch quant rollout (infra) 2) keep adjusted thresholds for 6 hours and review noise (oncall+platform) 3) add per-route error gating to page rules (platform) 4) postmortem if rollback confirmed (incident lead).
Chen: I'm starting rollback on the quant variant now — will monitor.
incident-bot: NOTE: handoff required in 40m. Next oncall: Morgan.
Alex: Morgan, when you take handoff, please verify the p99 trend and whether thresholds can be nudged back down. Also check per-tenant impact for the enterprise customers mentioned.
Morgan: got it. i'll pick this up at handoff. short term looks stable — p99 ~1.0s avg after reroute.
Priya: marking this thread as "live-mitigations" and leaving a quick summary in the incident log. will follow up with a runbook tweak for deploy gating on quantized variants. :memo:
Riley: thanks team. afterwards let's iterate on the alert playbook so sensitivity -> squelch -> per-model overrides are documented.
Sam: +1 — i'll add a section in runbook: "When p99 spikes coincide with recent model deploy: prefer routing -> model-specific thresholds -> error gating -> rollback".
Chen: rolling status: rollback finished, metrics look steady. will continue to watch.
Alex: cool. follow-up: schedule a 30m post-incident review in eng-oncall tomorrow to finalize thresholds and dashboards. :calendar:
